title: Grilled Octopus
description: Tender grilled octopus marinated in olive oil, lemon, and herbs, served with a sprinkle of paprika. A Mediterranean delight with a smoky flavor.

title: Squid Ink Pasta
description: Delicious pasta infused with squid ink, served with a seafood sauce and topped with fresh parsley. A visually striking dish with rich flavors.

title: Fried Calamari
description: Crispy fried calamari rings served with marinara sauce and lemon wedges. A classic appetizer that's crunchy and delicious.

title: Stuffed Squid
description: Tender squid stuffed with a flavorful mixture of breadcrumbs, herbs, and seafood, then baked to perfection. A hearty and satisfying dish.

title: Octopus Salad
description: Light and refreshing salad featuring tender octopus, mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and a lemon vinaigrette. Perfect for a summer meal.

title: Octopus Carpaccio
description: Thinly sliced octopus drizzled with olive oil and lemon juice, garnished with capers and arugula. A delicate and flavorful dish.

title: Squid Salad
description: Refreshing salad made with tender squid, bell peppers, olives, and a tangy vinaigrette. A perfect starter or light main dish.

title: Octopus Stew
description: Hearty octopus stew simmered with tomatoes, potatoes, and spices. A comforting dish that's perfect for cooler weather.

title: Spicy Grilled Squid
description: Grilled squid marinated in a spicy sauce, served with a side of dipping sauce. A flavorful dish that's perfect for those who love heat.

title: Crispy Octopus Bites
description: Tender octopus pieces coated in seasoned breadcrumbs and fried until crispy. Served with a garlic aioli for dipping.
